name: saints-2027
description: SAINTS 2027 conference website (static). Run `npm run build:css` after changing Tailwind classes in the HTML or JS, or editing assets/styles/main.css (it also writes main.min.css, which the pages load), and `npm run snapshot` after the Google Sheet changes.

scripts.build:css: tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.js -i assets/styles/tailwind.src.css -o assets/styles/tailwind.css --minify && esbuild assets/styles/main.css --minify --outfile=assets/styles/main.min.css
scripts.netlify: npm run build:css && npm run stamp && node tools/netlify.js
